import {orient, scout, goTo, note, outcome} from 'play';

export default async function main() {
  const look = await orient();
  const here = look.now?.location?.docked_at ?? 'nowhere';
  const places = await scout();
  const target =
    look.next?.[0]?.call === 'scout(system_id)' && look.next?.[0]?.arg ?
      'system_' + look.next[0].arg
      : places.next?.[0]?.call === 'scout(system_id)' && places.next?.[0]?.arg ?
        'system_' + places.next[0].arg
        : look.next?.[0]?.call === 'goTo(id)' && look.next?.[0]?.arg ?
          look.next[0].arg
          : null;
  if (!target) return outcome('scouted; nothing farther to look at yet', 'done', {scouted: places.detail});
  const want = look.next?.[0]?.call === 'scout(system_id)' ?
    `scouting ${target} for POIs` : `heading to ${target}`;
  note(`${want} (${look.next?.[0]?.why})`);
  if (look.next?.[0]?.call === 'scout(system_id)') {
    const out = await goTo(target);
    return out.status === 'done' ? scout() : out;
  }
  return goTo(target);
}

```ts
import {orient, missions, acceptMission, completeMissions, note, outcome} from 'play';
import type {Outcome} from 'play';

// A mission row as it appears on the board. We read a few likely field names defensively.
type BoardRow = {
  id?: string;
  mission_id?: string;
  reward?: number;
  credits?: number;
  base_reward?: number;
};

function rowId(m: BoardRow): string | undefined {
  return m.id ?? m.mission_id;
}

function rowReward(m: BoardRow): number {
  return m.reward ?? m.credits ?? m.base_reward ?? 0;
}

function rowTitle(m: BoardRow): string {
  const t = (m as Record<string, unknown>).title ?? (m as Record<string, unknown>).name ?? (m as Record<string, unknown>).description;
  return typeof t === 'string' && t.length > 0 ? t : (rowId(m) ?? 'mission');
}

export default async function main(): Promise<Outcome<unknown>> {
  // 1. Where am I and what is my mission capacity?
  const look = await orient();
  const ship = look.now?.ship ?? look.detail.present?.ship;
  const shipLike = (ship ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const totalSlots = Number(shipLike.mission_slots ?? shipLike.slots ?? 0) || 0;
  const active = Array.isArray(shipLike.missions) ? (shipLike.missions as unknown[]).length
    : Array.isArray(shipLike.active_missions) ? (shipLike.active_missions as unknown[]).length
    : 0;
  const freeSlots = Math.max(0, totalSlots - active);

  // 2. The board here, filtered to reward >= 100.
  const board = await missions();
  const detail = board.detail as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  const list: BoardRow[] =
    (Array.isArray(detail?.missions) ? detail.missions
      : Array.isArray(detail?.listings) ? detail.listings
      : Array.isArray(detail?.board) ? detail.board
      : []) as BoardRow[];

  const candidates = list.filter(m => rowReward(m) >= 100);

  // 3. Accept up to the free slots; stop at the first acceptMission that is not done.
  let accepted = 0;
  for (const m of candidates) {
    if (accepted >= freeSlots) break;
    const id = rowId(m);
    if (!id) continue; // no id we can accept
    const res = await acceptMission(id);
    if (res.status !== 'done') {
      note(`stopped accepting: ${res.why ?? res.did ?? 'acceptMission not done'}`);
      break;
    }
    accepted++;
  }

  // 4. Complete what is active; note why if it did not finish, and carry on.
  const done = await completeMissions();
  if (done.status !== 'done') {
    note(`completeMissions not done: ${done.why ?? done.did ?? 'unknown'}`);
  }

  // 5. Final report.
  return outcome(
    `Listed ${list.length} mission(s) at sol_station, accepted ${accepted} with reward >= 100, then completed missions${done.status === 'done' ? '' : ` (note: ${done.why ?? ''})`}.`,
    'done',
    { accepted },
  );
}
```

import {orient, missions, acceptMission, completeMissions, note, outcome} from 'play';

// A mission as it appears on the board. The lib's exact field names vary, so we read a
// few likely spellings defensively rather than guessing one.
type BoardRow = {
  id?: string;
  mission_id?: string;
  reward?: number;
  credits?: number;
  base_reward?: number;
  title?: string;
  name?: string;
  description?: string;
};

function rowId(m: BoardRow): string | undefined {
  return m.id ?? m.mission_id;
}

function rowReward(m: BoardRow): number {
  return m.reward ?? m.credits ?? m.base_reward ?? 0;
}

function rowTitle(m: BoardRow): string {
  const t = m.title ?? m.name ?? m.description;
  return t && t.length > 0 ? t : rowId(m) ?? 'mission';
}

export default async function main() {
  // 1. Where am I, and how many mission slots are free?
  const look = await orient();
  const shipLike = (look.now?.ship ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const activeList: unknown[] = Array.isArray(shipLike.missions)
    ? (shipLike.missions as unknown[])
    : Array.isArray(shipLike.active_missions)
      ? (shipLike.active_missions as unknown[])
      : [];
  const totalSlots = Number(shipLike.mission_slots ?? shipLike.slots ?? 0) || 0;
  const freeSlots = Math.max(0, totalSlots - activeList.length);
  // When we could not read a slot total, fall back to letting acceptMission itself guard:
  // the first non-done accept stops the loop.
  const slotLimit = totalSlots > 0 ? freeSlots : null;

  // 2. The board here, narrowed to reward >= 100 and not already active.
  const board = await missions();
  const detail = board.detail as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  const rows: BoardRow[] = (
    Array.isArray(detail?.missions) ? detail.missions
    : Array.isArray(detail?.listings) ? detail.listings
    : Array.isArray(detail?.board) ? detail.board
    : []
  ) as BoardRow[];

  const activeIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const a of activeList) {
    const aid = (a as BoardRow).id ?? (a as BoardRow).mission_id;
    if (aid) activeIds.add(aid);
  }

  const candidates = rows.filter((m) => {
    const id = rowId(m);
    if (!id) return false;
    if (activeIds.has(id)) return false;
    return rowReward(m) >= 100;
  });

  // 3. Accept up to the free slots; stop at the first acceptMission that is not done.
  let accepted = 0;
  for (const m of candidates) {
    if (slotLimit !== null && accepted >= slotLimit) break;
    const res = await acceptMission(rowId(m)!);
    if (res.status !== 'done') {
      note(`stopped accepting: ${res.why ?? res.did ?? 'acceptMission not done'}`);
      break;
    }
    accepted++;
  }

  // 4. Complete what is active; if it does not finish, note why and carry on.
  const done = await completeMissions();
  if (done.status !== 'done') {
    note(`completeMissions not done: ${done.why ?? done.did ?? 'unknown'}`);
  }

  // 5. Report how many we accepted.
  const suffix = done.status === 'done' ? '' : `; completeMissions: ${done.why ?? 'incomplete'}`;
  return outcome(
    `Listed ${rows.length} mission(s) at sol_station, accepted ${accepted} with reward >= 100, completed missions${suffix}.`,
    'done',
    { accepted },
  );
}
